visual_logic.color_palette: Earth-tone brown and tan with dark mahogany 'racing stripes', running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.action: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The mid-flap motion is stabilized parallel to the frame boundaries.
visual_logic.environment: Grey-blue water. The drifting seagrass fragments and organic particulates are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The short-necked polycotylid plesiosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic angled flipper pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its elongated jaws, thick muscular torso, broad paddles (flattened toward the camera plane), and short tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
